analysis:
The only change in docs/reference/configuration.md is at line 410 on both sides. It adds `provider-swift/Sources/darkbloom/ClusterServiceCommand.swift` (`supervisorConfiguration`) as a reader of `DARKBLOOM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK` and extends the effect text to say the variable also skips the `darkbloom cluster` pair's update at its slot. This is documentation only. No code, endpoint, or control changes. The supplied units (base lines 1217-1659) are unchanged surrounding text about cluster link setup, address keeper and isolation commands, the console, and the chunk policy. None of that text is touched by the patch. I reviewed it for newly documented attack surface and found none.

The doc change does describe a behavior worth tracking against TB-003 and T-043. A same-user environment variable can suppress auto-update for the cluster supervisor. The variable already suppresses the daemon, start-mode and watchdog updates, so the cluster path extends an existing operator-controlled knob rather than adding a new trust boundary. The operator is already ADV-001 with OS-level control. I did not verify the code in ClusterServiceCommand.swift, since it is not in the supplied evidence. The next review pass should confirm that the variable does not bypass signed-artifact or qualification checks (A-017, T-054) beyond update timing. It should also confirm that the variable is not forwarded into privileged contexts such as the root-run link-fix commands. The documented privileged commands (osascript, launchd keeper, networksetup) are pre-existing and out of scope for this diff. No findings are reported.
